title: My Goal, My Dream & Present Continuous

scenes.t: {name} learns words for dreams: goal, try, step, plan, practice, celebrate, success, reach.
Samer is trying to get better at football.
He is kicking the ball and splashing in the mud.
Now, he is playing a match with his friends.
He is scoring a goal and is feeling very proud.
We use the present continuous for actions happening now: am / is / are + verb-ing. I am practicing. He is trying. They are celebrating.

items.a: One small part of a plan.
What you will do to reach a goal.
Show you are happy about something.
